dct_description_sm: The La Salle River Watershed, located in Southern Manitoba is approximately 2,400 km2 and has a population of approximately 14,000. A multi-year record of in-stream and edge-of-field hydrochemistry data extending from 2009 to 2022. The data include intensive event-based water discharge, water chemistry, snow surveys, and soil chemistry monitoring. The monitoring program was established in 2009 as part of the Lake Winnipeg Basin Initiative.
